place: Koblenz cable car and Ehrenbreitstein Fortress
title: Ride the Koblenz cable car to Ehrenbreitstein Fortress
supports: The official cable-car operator documents the combined cable-car journey and Ehrenbreitstein Fortress admission. The replacement Viator product is ACTIVE with one current or future schedule season; its sole option includes a private guided fortress tour, a two-way cable-car ride and itinerary-marked fortress admission.
hidden_gem_rationale: A prominent Koblenz landmark and transport experience; classified as non-gem.

publisher: Visit Norway / Visit Sognefjord and Viator
title: Cruise the Sognefjord from Bergen to Flåm
supports: Visit Norway documents the direct April-to-October passenger cruise from Bergen to Flåm through the Sognefjord. The replacement Viator product is ACTIVE with eight current or future schedule seasons and offers one-way, same-day round-trip and overnight round-trip options, all including Bergen-to-Flåm cruise admission.
hidden_gem_rationale: Norway's longest and best-known fjord is a headline destination; classified as non-gem.

publisher: Małopolska Wooden Architecture Route and Viator
title: Walk among the timber houses of Chochołów village
supports: The official Małopolska Wooden Architecture Route documents Chochołów's protected linear village of traditional log houses. The ACTIVE replacement product has three current or future schedule seasons and its sole itinerary includes a 15-minute village stop to see the historic inhabited wooden houses; the stop is included but brief.
hidden_gem_rationale: The preserved living village is a quieter cultural stop beside the more prominent Zakopane route; classified as a gem.
